notes: Independent re-measure of 7164c6e (HEAD 8111351, product code unchanged since 7164c6e) by a separate measurer, as README rule 2 requires; nothing in client/, contract/, contracts/, ui/ was changed. Image digests are identical to MVP-11.json (reproducible build). Verified: make ui, make images (arm64, desktop-linux), make contracts-test (572, Go = Python), make test, make adversaries-test, readonly-distros.sh, testlab-readonly-proof REQUIRE=1, own read-only-rootfs probe (5 distros), canary/run.sh plus own leak probe, testlab-up t1 + smoke t1 (16 steps; agents 24 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped), and on a fresh lab smoke t1 with SCHILD_AGENTS_SILENT=1 (see agent_smoke_steps with silent_step label). Kill (d): schild-api limited to 512 MiB; each run restarts schild-api (fresh rate counters), 40 s flood, 40 rps latency probe on the site for 50 s, memory sampled every 3 s. Baseline 10 runs without flood, hold 4x100 10, hold 6x100 10, signed 6x8 5, plus one run of the original flood.sh (hold 6x100 with control). New shapes (4 generators x 64 workers, 40 s): TCP connect/close churn (~93k connections), TLS handshake flood, slowloris, slow body just above MinBodyRate (80 KiB/s, 600 KiB), enrolment flood (~230k attempts); distributed slowloris from 70 addresses x 8 connections (saturates MaxConns 512); IPv6 slowloris and TLS flood over a temporary dual-stack network (4 containers in one /64). Result: 0 failed site requests in all 44 measured runs (34 under flood); 0 restarts; peak 166 MiB (signed). The 6x100 outlier of the original run (5/2121 503, ~1.3 s stall) did not reproduce in 11 hold-6x100 runs; the largest single-request latency in any run was 106 ms (hold4-7), baseline max 18.7 ms. Likely cause of the original outlier: a VM-wide stall of the Docker Desktop VM (the external docker-stats sampler also paused 4 s), i.e. host noise rather than schild; the 1 s eval_timeout turned it into 503s. That cannot be proven from here; with 0/11 the per-run rate of such stalls under 6x100 is below ~24 % (95 %). Observations, not kill hits: (1) the signed flood with a valid enrolled test key raises site p99 from a 5.8 ms median to 12.0 ms (Mann-Whitney p = 0.002, no failures), the CPU of 4 parallel verifications; (2) during the distributed slowloris a fresh address reached the agent listener only 12 of 20 times (afterwards 5/5): with >= 64 attacker addresses an attacker can delay agent deliveries (agents retry; sustained over 2x interval it would show "meldet sich nicht"); the docs already say to firewall the listener to the app VM network; (3) under load p50 drops below baseline (0.9 vs 2.9 ms) also in the control run against the sink: host CPU frequency, not schild. Harness note: agent-smoke.sh is not idempotent; a second run on the same lab fails 4 enrolment/retention steps (agent.json exists; host already at 30 reports). Not run: real non-container VMs, RHEL 8 / dnf5 paths, Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 and Alma with the gateway (only the check), x86_64.
